setting-header-description:
The top bar displays the app name, selected groups of variables, and the system time.

LP points and flags can be shown independently.
(The top bar takes up some screen space.)
setting-quality-description:
Choose an art size that fits your terminal window. Larger images may not fit.

You can also try reducing the terminal font size (usually with Ctrl+"-"; Ctrl+"+" increases it).
setting-art-style-description:
ANSI — colored blocks
ASCII mono — characters .,:+*?%@ in one color
Color ASCII — the same characters in the image's colors
setting-scene-filters-description: Turn off filters to make ASCII images easier to read. Characters and their tinting are preserved.
setting-text-speed-description:
Controls how quickly text appears.

Slow    - 0.04
Medium  - 0.025
Fast    - 0.01
Instant - 0
